class.name: RailVehiclePantograph
class.brief_description: One pantograph of a vehicle as it is built.
class.description: The configuration of one pantograph of a [RailVehiclePantographs]: the channel of the vehicle's [RailVehicleEnginePowerSource] it is raised by and feeds, and its geometry ([code]TAnimPant[/code] of the original) - where it stands and how its arms are built. How far it is raised is the component's state, not this resource's.

members.member: The channel of the power source the pantograph is raised by and feeds the voltage it reads to: the first (front) or the second (rear).
Whether the geometry below is known. A pantograph without it is not moved: it samples the wire where the vehicle stands and always reaches it.
The horizontal offset between the arms' ends [lb]m[rb].
Where the lower arm's pivot stands, in the vehicle's own space [lb]m[rb] - where the overhead wire is sampled.
The slider's top over its pivot [lb]m[rb].
